prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Preset Pet Archetype Selection Gallery: Redesign the pick_friend screen with a structured grid layout featuring clear pet personality archetypes and companion preview cards.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Choose Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Select a pet archetype to join you on your desktop.", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Select Companion Archetype", "style": "playful", "action": "choose", "role": "pet_choices"}]}}}
1: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In Screen to Final Onboarding Step: Move the sign_in step to occur right after waiting and before the final home_intro screen.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "sign_in", "home_intro"]}
2: [home, new_screen] Desktop Pet Render Diagnostic Screen: Insert a new verification screen after waiting to confirm screen overlay permissions and pet desktop rendering before finishing.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_check", "home_intro"], "waiting": {"headline": "Preparing Desktop Rendering", "body": "We are preparing your pet to appear on your screen overlay."}}
3: [finish, redesign] Desktop Mascot Controls Spotlight View: Redesign home_intro screen into a spotlight layout emphasizing key desktop pet control toggles.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Controlling Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open quick controls, hide, or interact.", "replace": {"home_welcome": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Right-Click for Controls", "style": "highlight", "role": "home_welcome"}]}}}
4: [sign_in, copy] Existing Account Pet Recovery Sign-In Copy: Update sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure users that signing in safeguards and restores their existing pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Save & Sync Your Pets", "body": "Logging in keeps your adopted companions safely saved to your account so you never lose them."}}
5: [adoption, new_flow] Guided Pet Style Customization Flow: Introduce a two-step companion customization sequence (new_pet_style and new_pet_details) before photo uploads.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_pet_style", "new_pet_details", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "pick_friend": {"headline": "Select Companion Base Model"}}
6: [choose_path, hint] Path Selection Guidance Hint: Add an explicit explanatory hint beneath the path selection screen clarifying the difference between quick preset and custom creation paths.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Choose Preset for an instant ready-to-use pet, or Custom to create a unique companion from your photos."}}
7: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Stage Layout: Change adoption_certificate layout to 'stage' to create a focused celebration moment before desktop asset rendering.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "body": "Your companion is officially registered and ready to move to your desktop."}}
8: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Launch Button Copy: Update the home_intro headline and primary call-to-action button label to explicitly prompt releasing the pet onto the desktop.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Ready to Meet You!", "button_label": "Release Pet to Desktop"}}
9: [home, wait_info] Asset Generation Progress & Time Indicator: Enable progress bar and estimated time indicators on the waiting screen during pet rendering.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "headline": "Creating Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Please wait while we render and place your pet on your desktop."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning pick_friend to a grid layout with choice cards maintains its core function of letting the user select a pet.
Reordering sign_in to occur after waiting is explicitly permitted under base rule 4.
Adding a new verification screen inside onboarding after waiting is permitted by base rule 4.
Redesigning home_intro layout and welcome component within onboarding is allowed under base rule 4.
Updating sign-in copy to explain account backup does not violate any base rules.
Adding new customization screens to the onboarding flow is allowed by base rule 4.
Adding an explanatory hint to choose_path helps clarify options without losing screen functionality or breaking rules.
Updating the adoption certificate layout while retaining its core function is permitted under base rules 2 and 4.
Updating copy on home_intro buttons and headlines is fully permitted within onboarding.
Adding progress and estimated time indicators to the waiting screen for a real wait is permitted under base rules 4 and 5.
